name: Katei Kyouin ~Sensei no Ecchi na Gohoubi~
original_name: 家貞教員～先生のエッチなごほうび～
source:
Parents who were worried about Tomoya, who had a low score on the liberal arts test, decided to ask for a tutor.

On the day of the visit, Tomoya was frustrated by his parents who hired a tutor, Erika, a beautiful woman with a clear body shape, appears and the hero is fascinated in an instant.

Erika has never been in contact with a man other than her father. She taught him without considering the distance so Erika admire Tomoya as his younger brother because of his original good care. The hero gets excited by Erika who is strangely close to the distance and rushes to the bathroom and masturbates.

The main character has a hobby of running a back site and surfing the internet comes up with a plan to train the teacher for a naughty reward.

translation:
担心文科成绩低的智也的家长决定请一位家教。

探访当天，朋也因父母聘请家庭教师而感到沮丧，身形清晰的美丽女子埃里卡出现，男主角瞬间被迷住。

除了她父亲之外，埃里卡从未与其他男人接触过。她不考虑距离地教导他，因此埃里卡（Erika）因他最初的良好照顾而将友也视为他的弟弟。英雄对距离异常近的埃里卡感到兴奋，冲进浴室自慰。

主角有经营后台网站的爱好，上网冲浪，想出了一个训练老师以获得顽皮奖励的计划。
